fusions.name: Straight to the Pupil
fusions.desc: Drives one stiffened strand into the eye of a target up to 8 tiles away, dealing 30 piercing damage that ignores armour and rises to 1.5 times that at full reach. The target is [Blunted] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Blinding Fringe
fusions.desc: Whips a curtain of hair across the faces of everything in a cone 3.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 11 damage and stunning each target for 1 second, with a 50% chance to leave it [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Swept Clear
fusions.desc: Sweeps the hair out of your eyes: your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Warding Knot
fusions.desc: Conjures a charm of knotted hair around a staring bead: your critical hit chance rises by 6%, your critical hit multiplier rises by 0.15, and each kill restores 3 health.
